authority: Issue-74 List 79 code 21 / List 243 codes 02-05: description 'must contain a UN number ... UN plus four digits'
xpath: not(ProductFormFeatureType = '21' and ProductFormFeatureValue = ('02','03','04','05')) or (exists(ProductFormFeatureDescription) and (every $d in ProductFormFeatureDescription satisfies matches(normalize-space($d), '^(UN|un) *[0-4][0-9]{3}$')))

authority: Issue-74 List 242 codes 02/03: description gives '[number] x [voltage]V' (value 04 'may use' excluded)
xpath: not(ProductFormFeatureType = '19' and ProductFormFeatureValue = ('02','03')) or (exists(ProductFormFeatureDescription) and (every $d in ProductFormFeatureDescription satisfies matches($d, '^([1-9][0-9]*) *([Xx×\*]) *(([0-9]|[1-9][0-9]+)\.?[0-9]+)[Vv]( *.+)?$')))

authority: Issue-74 List 79 codes 47/48/49: description = plots of GPS points (lat lon, comma/semicolon separated, |lat|<=90, -180<lon<=180)
xpath: not(ProductFormFeatureType = ('47','48','49')) or (every $d in ProductFormFeatureDescription satisfies (every $gps in tokenize(normalize-space($d), '[,;]') satisfies (matches(normalize-space($gps), '^[-+]?[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{1,6})? +[-+]?[0-9]{1,3}(\.[0-9]{1,6})?$') and abs(number(substring-before(normalize-space($gps), ' '))) le 90 and number(substring-after(normalize-space($gps), ' ')) le 180 and number(substring-after(normalize-space($gps), ' ')) gt -180)))

authority: Issue-74 List 79 code 47: 'Plot types with one, two or multiple points must not be mixed in a list of multiple plots'
xpath: not(ProductFormFeatureType = ('47','48','49')) or (every $d in ProductFormFeatureDescription satisfies (let $plots := tokenize(normalize-space($d), ';') return (every $p in $plots satisfies string-length($p) eq string-length(replace($p, ',', ''))) or (every $p in $plots satisfies string-length($p) - string-length(replace($p, ',', '')) eq 1) or (every $p in $plots satisfies string-length($p) - string-length(replace($p, ',', '')) ge 2)))

authority: Issue-74 List 79 code 50: a description, when present, is a UUID ('There may also be a UUID')
xpath: not(ProductFormFeatureType = '50') or (every $d in ProductFormFeatureDescription satisfies matches(normalize-space($d), '^[0-9A-Fa-f]{8}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}-[0-9A-Fa-f]{12}$'))

authority: Issue-74 List 241 code 31 (DOI beginning 10.5240/, 5 hyphens, hexadecimal suffix) - ONIX-stated structure; check-character alphabet [0-9A-Z] adopted from EIDR ID Format v1.51 (eidr.org, Jun 2024, directly fetched): the adoption only loosens the ONIX 'hexadecimal' reading and never rejects a value either authority permits. PROPOSED adoption (CTO).
xpath: not(AVItemIDType = '31') or matches(IDValue, '^10\.5240/[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}(-[0-9A-Fa-f]{4}){4}-[0-9A-Za-z]$')

authority: Issue-74 List 9 code 22: '10 characters (4 digits, one letter, then five digits)'
xpath: not(ProductClassificationType = '22') or matches(ProductClassificationCode, '^[0-9]{4}[A-Za-z][0-9]{5}$')

authority: Issue-74 List 175 B403/B405 'Use with <ProductForm> BG'; B404 'Use with <ProductForm> BB (or BG if particularly high-quality)'
xpath: (not(ProductFormDetail = ('B403','B405')) or ProductForm = 'BG') and (not(ProductFormDetail = 'B404') or ProductForm = ('BB','BG'))

authority: as above (ProductPart)
xpath: (not(ProductFormDetail = ('B403','B405')) or ProductForm = 'BG') and (not(ProductFormDetail = 'B404') or ProductForm = ('BB','BG'))

authority: Issue-74 List 249 code 43 + List 257 = {BRW, WHI, OFW, CRE}
xpath: not(SpecificationFeatureType = '43') or SpecificationFeatureValue = ('BRW','WHI','OFW','CRE')

authority: Issue-74 List 44 code 44: '14 digits (the SIREN plus a further five digits), without spaces, or occasionally an alphanumeric code' - blocking shape: no whitespace or punctuation; an all-numeric value is exactly 14 digits; an alphanumeric value is admitted (length not stated by ONIX)
xpath: let $t := *[matches(local-name(), 'IDType$')], $v := string(IDValue) return not($t = '44') or (matches($v, '^[0-9A-Za-z]+$') and (not(matches($v, '^[0-9]+$')) or matches($v, '^[0-9]{14}$')))

authority: INSEE: numerical SIRET incorporates a Luhn parity check (direct primary); La Poste exception (SIREN 356000000: digit sum multiple of 5, INSEE Sirene letter n°16, Nov 2013) evidenced only secondarily (fr.wikipedia quotation; sirene.fr unreachable, insee.fr copy not found). Not blocking unless the CTO adopts and pins the INSEE rule including the exception; evaluated only for all-numeric 14-digit values, so it never rejects an alphanumeric SIRET.
xpath: let $t := *[matches(local-name(), 'IDType$')], $v := string(IDValue) return not($t = '44' and matches($v, '^[0-9]{14}$')) or (sum(for $i in 1 to 14 return (let $d := number(substring($v,$i,1)) return if ($i mod 2 = 1) then (let $x := $d*2 return if ($x gt 9) then $x - 9 else $x) else $d)) mod 10 eq 0) or (starts-with($v,'356000000') and (sum(for $i in 1 to 14 return number(substring($v,$i,1))) mod 5 eq 0))

authority: Issue-74 List 92 code 45: '12-digits (or 11 digits plus X)'; the check-digit algorithm coded in _20241125_a_76 is EXTERNAL_ADOPTION_REQUIRED (advisory)
xpath: let $t := *[matches(local-name(), 'IDType$')] return not($t = '45' and local-name() = 'LocationIdentifier') or matches(IDValue, '^[0-9]{11}[0-9X]$')

authority: INSEE: numerical SIRET incorporates a Luhn parity check (direct primary); La Poste exception (SIREN 356000000: digit sum multiple of 5, INSEE Sirene letter n°16, Nov 2013) evidenced only secondarily (fr.wikipedia quotation; sirene.fr unreachable, insee.fr copy not found). Not blocking unless the CTO adopts and pins the INSEE rule including the exception; evaluated only for all-numeric 14-digit values, so it never rejects an alphanumeric SIRET.
xpath: let $t := *[matches(local-name(), 'IDType$')], $v := string(IDValue) return not($t = '44' and matches($v, '^[0-9]{14}$')) or (sum(for $i in 1 to 14 return (let $d := number(substring($v,$i,1)) return if ($i mod 2 = 1) then (let $x := $d*2 return if ($x gt 9) then $x - 9 else $x) else $d)) mod 10 eq 0) or (starts-with($v,'356000000') and (sum(for $i in 1 to 14 return number(substring($v,$i,1))) mod 5 eq 0))

authority: Issue-74 List 92 code 45: '12-digits (or 11 digits plus X)'; the check-digit algorithm coded in _20241125_a_76 is EXTERNAL_ADOPTION_REQUIRED (advisory)

authority: Issue-74 List 30 codes 15, 16, 17, 18: 'values in <AudienceRangeValue> must be integers' (every value; the official <=1000/<=120 bounds are not mandated; _c_5/_c_6 are inert)
xpath: not(AudienceRangeQualifier = ('15','16','17','18')) or (every $v in AudienceRangeValue satisfies matches(normalize-space($v), '^[0-9]+$'))

authority: Issue-74 List 32 code 06 describes the Lexile form by example only ('880L', 'AD0L', 'HL600L'); the full scheme (codes, multiples of 5, caps) is owned by MetaMetrics and not pinned. Advisory unless adopted.
xpath: not(ComplexitySchemeIdentifier = '06') or matches(normalize-space(ComplexityCode), '^(NP|[A-Z]{0,2}[0-9]+L)$')

authority: Issue-74 List 48 linear dimensions (01-05, 09-16, 19-21, 23-25 and the Issue-74 pallet dimensions 27-29) must use a List 50 length unit (mm, cm, in, px) and only they may; the official set omits 27-29 (medium confidence on the codelist-label reading)
P.27.71 Date: format 13 (explicit, via <DateFormat>, or the default) is YYYYMMDDThhmm optionally followed by Z or a ±hhmm offset; List 55 code 13. The official regex whitelists specific offsets.

Tax composite: 'used only when <PriceType> indicates an inc-tax price'; P.26.43: PriceType may be omitted when a Header <DefaultPriceType> is given (effective type = PriceType else DefaultPriceType); inc-tax set = Issue-74 List 58 {02,04,07,09,12,14,17,22,24,27,34,42}
xpath: not(exists(Tax)) or matches((let $pt := (PriceType, ancestor::ONIXMessage/Header/DefaultPriceType)[1] return string($pt)), '^(02|04|07|09|12|14|17|22|24|27|34|42)$')

authority: P.26.70a TaxExempt: 'used only when <PriceType> indicates an exc-tax price' (effective type as above); exc-tax set = List 58 {01,03,05,06,08,11,13,15,21,23,25,31,32,33,41} plus the Issue-74 codes 35, 36, 37 ('excluding tax') the official rule omits
xpath: not(exists(TaxExempt)) or matches((let $pt := (PriceType, ancestor::ONIXMessage/Header/DefaultPriceType)[1] return string($pt)), '^(01|03|05|06|08|11|13|15|21|23|25|31|32|33|35|36|37|41)$')

authority: Issue-74 List 146: a limit may occur only with status 02 'Permitted subject to limit' (codes 01 unlimited / 03 prohibited exclude a limit); the converse ('limit should be specified') is a should
xpath: not(exists(PriceConstraintLimit)) or PriceConstraintStatus = '02'

authority: P.27 ContributorReference/NameIdentifier 'must match a name identifier in an instance of <Contributor> ... or <NameAsSubject> ... in the same Product record'; contextual on a block update that omits Blocks 1 and 3
guard: NotificationType 04 without DescriptiveDetail and ContentDetail: admitted (contextual)
xpath: not(exists(PromotionDetail/PromotionalEvent/ContributorReference/NameIdentifier)) or (NotificationType = '04' and not(exists(DescriptiveDetail)) and not(exists(ContentDetail))) or (every $name in PromotionDetail/PromotionalEvent/ContributorReference/NameIdentifier satisfies exists((DescriptiveDetail/Contributor/NameIdentifier | DescriptiveDetail/Contributor/AlternativeName/NameIdentifier | DescriptiveDetail/Collection/Contributor/NameIdentifier | DescriptiveDetail/Collection/Contributor/AlternativeName/NameIdentifier | DescriptiveDetail/NameAsSubject/NameIdentifier | DescriptiveDetail/NameAsSubject/AlternativeName/NameIdentifier | ContentDetail/ContentItem/Contributor/NameIdentifier | ContentDetail/ContentItem/Contributor/AlternativeName/NameIdentifier | ContentDetail/ContentItem/NameAsSubject/NameIdentifier)[NameIDType = $name/NameIDType][not(exists(IDTypeName)) or IDTypeName = $name/IDTypeName][IDValue = $name/IDValue]))

authority: Product identifier composite (product part, P.28): 'mandatory and repeatable when <ProductPart> is present within the Product record, but must be omitted if there are no product parts'; contextual on a block update that omits Block 1 or Block 8
guard: NotificationType 04 without DescriptiveDetail or without ProductionDetail: admitted
xpath: (NotificationType = '04' and (not(exists(DescriptiveDetail)) or not(exists(ProductionDetail)))) or ((exists(DescriptiveDetail/ProductPart) and exists(ProductionDetail)) eq exists(ProductionDetail/ProductionManifest/ProductIdentifier))

authority: Issue-74 List 9 code 20: 'EU TARIC Document codes, 4 alphanumeric characters (usually 1 letter, 3 digits)'
xpath: not(ProductClassificationType = '20') or matches(ProductClassificationCode, '^[A-Za-z0-9]{4}$')

authority: Issue-74 List 79 code 16: '<ProductFormFeatureValue> is the version number of the validator' (presence; no syntax is mandated)
xpath: not(ProductFormFeatureType = '16') or normalize-space(string(ProductFormFeatureValue)) ne ''

authority: Issue-74 List 79 code 47: value = List 91 country code, optionally a space and a species name (Latin binomial, optionally + '(common name)'; or a comma-separated list of such names), optionally a space and a harvest date (YYYY, YYYYMM or YYYYMMDD); the official regex admits only one species and 20xx dates
xpath: not(ProductFormFeatureType = ('47','48','49')) or matches(normalize-space(string(ProductFormFeatureValue)), '^(AD|AE|AF|AG|AI|AL|AM|AN|AO|AQ|AR|AS|AT|AU|AW|AX|AZ|BA|BB|BD|BE|BF|BG|BH|BI|BJ|BL|BM|BN|BO|BQ|BR|BS|BT|BV|BW|BY|BZ|CA|CC|CD|CF|CG|CH|CI|CK|CL|CM|CN|CO|CR|CS|CU|CV|CW|CX|CY|CZ|DE|DJ|DK|DM|DO|DZ|EC|EE|EG|EH|ER|ES|ET|FI|FJ|FK|FM|FO|FR|GA|GB|GD|GE|GF|GG|GH|GI|GL|GM|GN|GP|GQ|GR|GS|GT|GU|GW|GY|HK|HM|HN|HR|HT|HU|ID|IE|IL|IM|IN|IO|IQ|IR|IS|IT|JE|JM|JO|JP|KE|KG|KH|KI|KM|KN|KP|KR|KW|KY|KZ|LA|LB|LC|LI|LK|LR|LS|LT|LU|LV|LY|MA|MC|MD|ME|MF|MG|MH|MK|ML|MM|MN|MO|MP|MQ|MR|MS|MT|MU|MV|MW|MX|MY|MZ|NA|NC|NE|NF|NG|NI|NL|NO|NP|NR|NU|NZ|OM|PA|PE|PF|PG|PH|PK|PL|PM|PN|PR|PS|PT|PW|PY|QA|RE|RO|RS|RU|RW|SA|SB|SC|SD|SE|SG|SH|SI|SJ|SK|SL|SM|SN|SO|SR|SS|ST|SV|SX|SY|SZ|TC|TD|TF|TG|TH|TJ|TK|TL|TM|TN|TO|TR|TT|TV|TW|TZ|UA|UG|UM|US|UY|UZ|VA|VC|VE|VG|VI|VN|VU|WF|WS|YE|YT|YU|ZA|ZM|ZW)( [A-Z][a-z-]+ [a-z-]+( \([^()]+\))?(, ?[A-Z][a-z-]+ [a-z-]+( \([^()]+\))?)*)?( ([0-9]{4}|[0-9]{6}|[0-9]{8}))?$')

authority: Issue-74 List 79 code 51: '<ProductFormFeatureValue> is a space-separated list of document references for DDSs' (non-empty token list; the token alphabet is only 'expected to be in a format like')
xpath: not(ProductFormFeatureType = '51') or matches(normalize-space(string(ProductFormFeatureValue)), '^\S+( \S+)*$')

authority: Product identifier composite (product part, P.28): identifier 'must match a product identifier in an instance of the <ProductPart> composite'
xpath: (NotificationType = '04' and not(exists(DescriptiveDetail))) or (every $id in ProductionDetail/ProductionManifest/ProductIdentifier satisfies exists(DescriptiveDetail/ProductPart/ProductIdentifier[ProductIDType = $id/ProductIDType][not(exists(IDTypeName)) or IDTypeName = $id/IDTypeName][IDValue = $id/IDValue]))

authority: 'Where multiple product identifiers are provided in any one occurrence of the <ProductionManifest> composite, they must all identify the same product part'
xpath: (NotificationType = '04' and not(exists(DescriptiveDetail))) or (every $m in ProductionDetail/ProductionManifest[count(ProductIdentifier) gt 1] satisfies exists(DescriptiveDetail/ProductPart[every $id in $m/ProductIdentifier satisfies exists(ProductIdentifier[ProductIDType = $id/ProductIDType][IDValue = $id/IDValue])]))

authority: Tax/ProductIdentifier: 'All identifiers included here must also be included in an instance of <ProductPart>, and ... they must all identify the same product part'
xpath: (NotificationType = '04' and not(exists(DescriptiveDetail))) or (every $t in ProductSupply/SupplyDetail/Price/Tax[ProductIdentifier] satisfies exists(DescriptiveDetail/ProductPart[every $id in $t/ProductIdentifier satisfies exists(ProductIdentifier[ProductIDType = $id/ProductIDType][IDValue = $id/IDValue])]))

authority: SupplementManifest/ProductIdentifier 'must not match a product identifier within Group P.2 or in an instance of the <ProductPart> composite'
guard: the ProductPart half is admitted on a NotificationType 04 record without DescriptiveDetail; the Group P.2 half is always evaluable
xpath: every $s in ProductionDetail/ProductionManifest/SupplementManifest/ProductIdentifier satisfies (not(exists(ProductIdentifier[ProductIDType = $s/ProductIDType][IDValue = $s/IDValue])) and ((NotificationType = '04' and not(exists(DescriptiveDetail))) or not(exists(DescriptiveDetail/ProductPart/ProductIdentifier[ProductIDType = $s/ProductIDType][IDValue = $s/IDValue]))))

authority: List 13 code 38: 'Unhyphenated, 8 digits' (blocking: 8 characters, unhyphenated; the final-position X of ISO 3297 is admitted, which only loosens the ONIX reading)
xpath: not(CollectionIDType = '38') or matches(IDValue, '^[0-9]{7}[0-9X]$')

authority: List 17 Z01/Z05/Z06: 'Contributor must follow another contributor'
xpath: not(ContributorRole = ('Z01','Z05','Z06')) or (let $s := SequenceNumber return if ($s) then exists(../Contributor[number(SequenceNumber) lt number($s)]) else exists(preceding-sibling::Contributor))

authority: List 17 Z04: 'Use with <UnnamedPersons> code 02 as a flag'
xpath: not(ContributorRole = 'Z04') or UnnamedPersons = '02'

authority: List 17 Z98: 'For use ONLY with et al or Various within <UnnamedPersons>'
xpath: not(ContributorRole = 'Z98') or UnnamedPersons = ('03','04')

authority: List 17 B33: 'Use with ... B03, B07 or A28'
xpath: not(ContributorRole = 'B33') or exists(../Contributor[ContributorRole = ('B03','B07','A28')])

authority: List 21 AVS: 'Use <EditionStatement> to describe the nature of the anniversary'
xpath: not(EditionType = 'AVS') or exists(EditionStatement)

authority: List 44 code 42: 'as 20 alphanumeric characters without spaces or hyphens' (ISO 17442 check digits not enforced: external)
xpath: not(NameIDType = '42') or matches(IDValue, '^[A-Z0-9]{20}$')

authority: List 79 code 42: '<ProductFormFeatureDescription> is a certificate or license number'

authority: List 220 notes 'Use only with <ProductFormDetail> code(s) ...' (101A: E101/E102; 101B-101F: E101; 107C-107J: E107/E108; 116A: E116/E127; 116B/116C: E116)
